connectsTo: The owner's Jobber account, through Jobber's GraphQL API (OAuth, using a developer app registered in Jobber's Developer Center).
permissions: Jobber app scopes for reading clients and quotes only. Jobber sets scopes on the developer app, not in the sign-in link. Exact scope names TO CONFIRM in the Developer Center: public docs did not list them.
riskNote: This is a weak candidate and the reviewer should decide whether to use it. It is an unofficial, third-party server with about 3 stars and no tagged releases (npm 1.0.1, March 2026). It includes write tools (create client, update client, create quote, create job) and has no read-only mode, so read-only has to come from the Jobber app's scopes (TO CONFIRM they can be limited to read) or from hiding the write tools. A different third-party Jobber server (friendlygeorge/jobber-mcp-server) is archived and was rejected. Option to consider instead: a small read-only script against Jobber's GraphQL API, which avoids third-party code that sees customer data. Handles customer names, emails and quote amounts.
